description: This file defines the interface for the auto-hinter module in the FreeType project, including function types, structures, and macros for managing global hints and glyph loading for font hinting.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlobalGetFunc
methods.description: Retrieves global hints for a font face, returning a typeless pointer and its size.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlobalDoneFunc
methods.description: Discards global hints retrieved earlier to free memory.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlobalResetFunc
methods.description: Recomputes global font metrics, useful when font data changes.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlyphLoadFunc
methods.description: Loads, scales, and hints a glyph from a font face.
